project_comments.note: SYSTEMIC ARCHITECTURAL BREAK — GUI API slug-based handlers: Every function in gui/api.ts that receives a project slug (handleGetProject, handleListWorkPackages, handleGetWorkPackage, handleDeleteProject, handleArchiveProject, handleUnarchiveProject, handleMarkProjectComplete, handleGetPlanDocument, handleGetSynthesisDocument, handleResetProject, handleRenameProject, handleGetProjectHealth, handleGetInsights) calls new LedgerStore(slug, ledgerRoot) where slug is a bare string like '2026-05-27-feature'. deriveRepoName() requires an absolute plan_path with 4 directory levels above the slug folder to infer the repo namespace. Given a bare slug, it returns 'unknown', so storageDir = {ledgerRoot}/unknown/{slug}/ — which is not the actual storage location. ledgerDirExists() returns false for every project, causing 'Project not found' for all namespace-stored projects. Additionally, direct join(ledgerRoot, slug, ...) constructions in handleDeleteProject (rm), handleGetPlanDocument, handleGetSynthesisDocument, handleListDialogues, handleGetDialogueFile, handleListChunks, and handleGetChunkFile all use the old flat path. Recommended fix pattern: resolve the project via listAllProjects(), obtain meta.plan_path, then construct LedgerStore(meta.plan_path, ledgerRoot). For rm/file-path operations, use store.storageDir instead of join(ledgerRoot, slug). Root cause: WP-001/WP-002 changed the storage layout but did not update gui/api.ts. This must be addressed in a dedicated WP before release — it renders the entire GUI non-functional for namespaced projects.

Duplicate assertSafeSlug implementations span two modules: run-log-handlers.ts (throws ApiError NOT_FOUND) and ledger-root.ts (throws plain Error). Both use SAFE_SLUG_REGEX from constants.ts. The separation is intentional (GUI layer vs storage layer error types) but creates divergence risk as the codebase grows. Before a third consumer appears, consider extracting a shared assertSafeSegment(segment, ErrorClass) utility in src/utils/ to eliminate duplication while preserving the per-layer error type contract.
Pipeline documentation on WP-010 completed with PASS but declared no artifacts.files_modified — consider declaring modified files for traceability

FOLLOW-UP WP REQUIRED (blocking for full namespace completeness): handleListDialogues, handleGetDialogueFile, handleListChunks, handleGetChunkFile in gui/api.ts still use join(ledgerRoot, slug, DIR) non-namespaced paths. All four accept repoName as a forward-compatibility stub but do not use it. Once projects are fully migrated to namespaced storage, these handlers will return empty results or serve stale data. Migration to resolveProjectStore() is the fix. Documented as KL-4 in constraints.md. Flagged by Developer (WP-011 debt note), confirmed by QA, Security Auditor, and Reviewer.

TECH DEBT: assertSafeSlug is duplicated across src/utils/ledger-root.ts (plain Error, storage layer) and src/gui/handlers/run-log-handlers.ts (ApiError NOT_FOUND, GUI layer). Both use SAFE_SLUG_REGEX from constants.ts. Separation is intentional (layer error types). Cross-reference JSDoc comments added to both files. Should be consolidated into src/utils/path-validator.ts before a third consumer appears. Documented as KL-3 in constraints.md.
